content: Sybr Safe is a viable alternative to the toxic compound Ethidium Bromide for use as a nucleic acid stain in gel electrophoresis procedures. For further details, please refer to the product page. The excitation and emission spectra of Sybr Safe are available, though the lower absorption peak is not depicted in the provided data. Users of SynGene gel imaging systems should be able to detect DNA stained with Sybr Safe by utilizing the transilluminator, a short band-pass emission filter, and an exposure time of 1 second. This has been tested using 1 μg of the NEB 2-Log DNA Ladder.
